notes: IFIP_SEC-X07_replay_generator (Phase P02, RQ1): implemented the deterministic replay-attack sequence builder generate_replays(seed, base_cases=None, n=8) -> list[ReplayAttack] in evaluation/venue2027/ifip_sec/replay_generator.py (REPLAY_GENERATOR_VERSION 1.0.0, schema clara.venue2027.ifip_sec.replay_attack.v1), realizing the task contract as the X07-specific counterpart to the dataset generator's Schedule contract (source_reference_map target replay_schedules.py 'generate(seed,families)->list[Schedule]'; this worktree delivers the replay-attack variant at the collision-checked path replay_generator.py per the deliverable spec - no pre-existing symbol was overwritten). Four attack families, each mutating exactly its declared primary field of a legitimate fresh_accept base request and encoding the dataset ground-truth signal convention: cross_purpose (purpose shifted away from granted_purpose; violates purpose_domain_separation, CASE-02), delegation_replay (nonce_state -> consumed_by_delegate; violates consume_once_nonce), lineage_splice (consent_epoch re-pointed to an epoch that no longer derives from parent_consent_epoch; violates delegation_ancestry_binding) and nonce_replay (nonce_state -> consumed, verbatim same-nonce duplicate presentation of an already-consumed receipt; violates consume_once_nonce). Every ReplayAttack records attack_id (seed-bound digest), family, mutated_field, original_request verbatim, mutated_request, violated_invariant (frozen VIOLATED_INVARIANTS table), expected_oracle_verdict (always REJECT) and the frozen independent-oracle rule-table binding ORACLE_FAMILY_FOR_ATTACK (cross_purpose -> cross_purpose_replay, lineage_splice -> lineage_splice, delegation_replay/nonce_replay -> delegation_replay; no dedicated nonce_replay row exists so it shares the consume-once row - an explicit mapping, not an invented rule). Round-robin family distribution guarantees all four families appear for n >= 4; ordering and content are pure functions of (seed, base_cases, n) - same inputs always yield identical output. Paired legitimate operation for every attacker variant via legitimate_control(attack) -> fresh_accept-shape request sharing actor/tenant/operation with the attack (expected ADMIT), per the task's 'paired legitimate operation for each attacker variant' requirement. Fail closed with stable reason codes via ReplayGeneratorError: INVALID_SEED, INVALID_N, INVALID_BASE_CASE (non-mapping, missing required fields, bad delegation_depth/replay_flag/nonce_state types, malformed consent-<int> epochs), UNKNOWN_FAMILY (smuggled family in base case or unknown mutator family) and UNMUTATED_REQUEST (a primary-field no-op - e.g. an already-consumed receipt offered to nonce_replay - is refused as not-an-attack, never silently returned), plus PHI_FIELD_PRESENT on PHI-like field names; all requests validated with the same synthetic-identifier discipline as the venue dataset.
